entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jean Riolan was a French anatomist who was an influential member of the Medical Faculty of Paris. His father, Jean Riolan (1539–1605) was also a noted French anatomist. Riolan was the personal physician to Marie de' Medici (1553–1642) for all his life.
